# The libm probe for the determinism workflow, built with the same float flags as the engine.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(lpf_determinism_probes LANGUAGES C)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin")
if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
	if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT STREQUAL "MSVC")
		add_compile_options(/clang:-ffp-contract=off)
	else()
		add_compile_options(-ffp-contract=off)
	endif()
elseif(MSVC)
	add_compile_options(/fp:precise)
	add_compile_definitions(_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()
add_executable(libm_probe libm_probe.c)
if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
	target_link_libraries(libm_probe m)
endif()
